subject: Decarbonization Outreach Campaign Proposal
overview: The committee finalized preparations for the 2023 Harvest Your Energy Festival and reviewed a $300,000 grant proposal for a multi-year decarbonization outreach campaign targeting environmental justice neighborhoods. Members also discussed technical infrastructure for curbside electric vehicle charging and a potential community solar initiative.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the September 11, 2023 meeting.

items.title: Administrative and Mailing List Updates
items.summary: Discussed technical troubleshooting for the committee's new email distribution list and staff coordination with local Boy and Girl Scout troops on environmental projects.

items.title: Harvest Your Energy Festival Planning
items.summary: Reviewed logistics for the October 14 festival, including the transition to a fee-based electronics recycling model, shuttle service coordination, and the scheduling of wind turbine tours.

items.title: Event Waste and Composting Logistics
items.summary: Debated the feasibility of composting at the festival following poor results at a recent Tufts event, ultimately deciding to focus on clear recycling signage and volunteer monitoring of trash barrels.

items.title: Decarbonization Outreach Campaign Grant
items.summary: Reviewed a $300,000 Empower Grant proposal to fund a two-year outreach program involving stipended energy ambassadors from priority language and environmental justice communities.

items.title: Flooding Resilience Webinar
items.summary: Scheduled a November 1 webinar regarding regional flooding and climate preparedness featuring Julie Wormser from the Mystic River Watershed Association.

items.title: Curbside EV Charging and Community Solar
items.summary: Discussed municipal grant-funded charging stations and a long-term initiative to develop a community solar model that bypasses the traditional subscription system to benefit low-income residents.
